g.text: Figure 4. One case through the method, Uiseong–Andong at 18:00 KST on 25 March 2025: the inputs (a); the M548 forecast, its four learned kernels at one cell and the

text.style: font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'NanumGothic'; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: next-hour burn probability (b); exposure, shown on Fish Creek because no Korean fuel maps exist (c); the known fire widened by the calibrated 8 h reach, which the

text.style: font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'NanumGothic'; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: gate withheld at this hour (d); and the backward pass that gives Wondang-ri a last safe departure of 18:15 and a route that a separate checker accepted (e–f), where

text.style: font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'NanumGothic'; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: the road blockages come from the detected fire and the reach, not from (b).
